Subject: [UAI] UM2007: 11th International Conference on User Modeling in Corfu, Greece (2ND CFP)


              Apologies if you receive this more than once.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

            11th International Conference on User Modeling
                    Corfu, Greece, 25-29 June, 2007
                  http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007

      The Call for Papers for UM2007 can be found at:
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/UM2007-CFP.pdf 
*** Submission deadline for posters and papers: November 1, 2006

    Additionally, the calls for workshops, tutorials and papers 
          for the doctoral consortium can be found at:
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/UM2007-Workshops.pdf 
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/UM2007-Tutorials.pdf 
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/UM2007-CFP-DC.pdf 
*** Submission deadline for workshop proposals: November 6, 2006
*** Submission deadline for tutorial proposals: November 6, 2006
*** Submission deadline for doctoral consortium papers: December 28, 2006

    Finally, you can also find the poster and the leaflet of the 
                         conference at:
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/poster(day).pdf 
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/poster(night).pdf       
        http://www.iit.demokritos.gr/um2007/UM2007-Leaflet.pdf 

                    See you in Corfu next June!
